annotations.title: Check a REWORK certificate by ID or link

description: Check a REWORK certificate from its ID or its link, which is what people usually share: whether REWORK holds it, whether it is active or revoked, and what its public page shows (holder, title, issue date, verified proofs and skills, and a verified result when there is one). Use this when you are given a certificate ID (such as RW-CERT-...) or a link to /verify/... or /certificates/share/....

certificate.description: A certificate ID, or a link to a REWORK certificate page (/verify/<id> or /certificates/share/<token>).

name: check_rework_certificate

active.description: Whether the certificate is active. Null when unknown.

assurance_note.description: The ceiling on what this result proves. Read it before relying on the result.

certificate.description: What the public page shows, for an active certificate only: holder, title, issued_at, verified_proofs, verified_skills, and verified_result when there is one.

found.description: Whether REWORK holds a certificate under this ID or link. Null when the records could not be read just now.

revoked.description: Whether REWORK revoked it. Null when unknown.

status.description: The certificate's status as REWORK records it.

title: Check a REWORK certificate by ID or link
